summary.name: RhodeCode
summary.one_liner: RhodeCode is a self-hosted source code management platform for Git, Subversion, and Mercurial repositories, with a web interface for browsing and managing them.
use_cases: host Git, Subversion and Mercurial repositories in one place
search across repositories for code, commits or files
manage user access to repositories and groups
summary.what_it_does: The page is the dashboard of a RhodeCode 5.12.0 Enterprise Edition instance. It provides a quick search box that supports prefixed queries for users, user groups, pull requests, commits and file paths, plus a link to global full text search. Navigation includes Home, a public journal, and gists, with keyboard shortcuts for repository summary, changelog, files, pull requests and settings. The listing describes it as a tool to unify and simplify repository management for Git, Subversion, and Mercurial.
notable: Supports Git, Subversion and Mercurial in one interface
Prefixed quick search for users, user groups, pull requests, commits and files
Listed as AGPL-3.0 licensed Python project on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: Page shows the Enterprise Edition dashboard; community vs. enterprise feature differences are not stated on this page
